# FDG4020

> DO define an interface if you need some common API to be supported by a set of types that includes value types.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.6 Interface Design.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Whether a common API must also be supported by value types is a design decision; not machine-checkable.
